title: Utility Services Program Water and Sewer Allocation Schedule
content:
# Water and Sewer Allocation Schedule — Utility Services Program

On a program that bills water and sewer by allocation, the community's water and sewer provider bill is shared among occupied apartment homes using a common-area deduction, an occupant weight, a square-footage weight, occupant factors by the number of billed occupants, and a monthly cap per apartment home. The figures for every program are below.

## Allocation figures by program

| Program | Common-area deduction (share of the community bill) | Weight of the occupant factor | Weight of square footage | Cap on one month's allocation for one apartment home, per service |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Essentials Utility Plan | 0% | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan | 15% | 0.5 | 0.5 | $125.00 |
| Submetered Water Plan | 0% | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Submetered Water & Gas Plan | 0% | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |
| Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan | 0% | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |
| All-Inclusive Utility Package | 0% | 0 | 0 | $0.00 |

The occupant weight and the square-footage weight together sum to one on the Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan (one half each).

## Occupant factors (Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan)

| Billed occupants | Occupant factor |
|---|---|
| 1 | 1.0 |
| 2 | 1.6 |
| 3 | 2.2 |
| 4 | 2.6 |
| 5 or more | 3.0 |

The five-person factor applies to five or more billed occupants. No other program carries occupant factors.

## Points of reading

- An apartment home with six billed occupants on the Water-Sewer-Trash Allocation Plan takes the factor of 3.0, the same as one with five.
- The 15% common-area deduction is a share of the community water and sewer bill; it is not a dollar amount.
- The $125.00 cap applies per service per month for one apartment home.
